title: Refresh /quit-vaping for "how to quit vaping" (thin page, vaping support now confirmed)
body:
URL: /quit-vaping
Cluster: how to quit vaping
Type: refresh
Source: Keyword Planner US + UK 2026-11-02, GSC 2026-10-03..2026-10-30, inventory 2026-11-02

## Evidence
- Keyword Planner US (monthly): "quit vaping" 5,400, "best way to quit vaping" 2,900, "stop vaping" 2,400, "ways to quit vaping" 1,000, "quitting vaping cold turkey" 1,000. UK: "quit vaping" 2,900. Ads competition is HIGH, which says nothing about organic difficulty.
- GSC: /quit-vaping has 8 impressions at average position 7.5 in the window, so Google already tests it for the intent.
- Inventory: 651 words, flagged thin, 4 FAQs, last modified 2026-10-13, indexed (last crawl 2026-09-18).
- The owner confirmed on 2026-10-27 that Blou supports quitting vaping (seo/blou-profile.md), so this page can now recommend the app.
- SERP check (web search, 2026-11-02): NHS, WebMD, HSE Ireland, vaping360 and several syndicated news copies. Strong authorities at the top, weak pages below them.

## Recommended action
Refresh in place to about 1,600 words: answer-first plan (pick a date, cold turkey vs tapering, triggers, what withdrawal feels like with a link to /vape-withdrawal-symptoms, NRT options linking to /nrt-for-vaping once BLO-34 ships, free help such as This is Quitting and Smokefree.gov), a short taper table, FAQ from the GSC and Keyword Planner variants, sources (NHS, CDC, Smokefree.gov, Truth Initiative).
Do not invent vaping-specific app features (no puff counting, no device sync); describe Blou only with APP_FEATURES. Do not present vapes as a quit method. Coordinate with BLO-35 (/quit-vaping-app landing page) and BLO-17 (vaping timeline cannibalization) so the three pages split intent: how-to here, app choice on the landing page, timeline on /quit-vaping-timeline.

## Next skill
seo-content-brief

## Done when
Within 28 days of publishing the page has 100+ impressions for the cluster, an average position under 30 for "how to quit vaping", and at least one click.

title: Refresh /quit-smoking-with-nicotine-lozenge for "nicotine lozenge" (2mg vs 4mg, how to use)
body:
URL: /quit-smoking-with-nicotine-lozenge
Cluster: nicotine lozenge to quit smoking
Type: refresh
Source: Keyword Planner US + UK 2026-11-02, GSC 2026-10-03..2026-10-30, inventory 2026-11-02

## Evidence
- Keyword Planner US (monthly): "nicotine lozenge" 18,100 (head term), "nicotine lozenges 4mg" 1,900, "nicotine lozenge 2mg" 1,600, "nicorette nicotine lozenges" 1,000 (trend up 1.55x), "nicotine polacrilex lozenge" 480, "quit smoking lozenges" 390. UK "lozenge nicotine" 2,900 (up 1.15x).
- The page has 491 words (thin), 4 FAQs, last modified 2026-10-13, indexed since September, and 0 GSC impressions in both windows.
- SERP check (web search, 2026-11-02): quitline and hospital fact sheets (Roswell Park, National Jewish, UW CTRI, EX Program), a brand blog and a cluster of spam pages. The 2mg vs 4mg question is answered only in PDFs and brand blogs.
- Same medication cluster as BLO-28 (patch), BLO-29 (bupropion) and BLO-30 (gum); NRT is priority topic 3.

## Recommended action
Refresh in place to about 1,400 words: answer first (how to use a lozenge, which strength), a 2mg vs 4mg table based on time to first cigarette, how to use it (dissolve, don't chew, no food or drink 15 minutes before), daily limits and the 12-week taper as printed on the label, common side effects (hiccups, heartburn, nausea) and when to switch strength, combining with the patch (link /combination-nrt-quit-smoking and /quit-smoking-with-nicotine-patch). Sources: FDA label wording, Smokefree.gov, NHS, MedlinePlus.
No dosing beyond the label and NHS/CDC guidance. Don't target retail queries (Walgreens, CVS, near me). Reuse the comparison table format chosen for BLO-30 so the NRT pages match.

## Done when
Within 28 days of publishing the page shows impressions for "nicotine lozenge 4mg" or "nicotine lozenge 2mg" with an average position under 30.

title: Refresh /quit-smoking-cold-turkey (crawled, not indexed since May; 1,600/mo cluster)
body:
URL: /quit-smoking-cold-turkey
Cluster: quit smoking cold turkey
Type: refresh
Source: Keyword Planner US 2026-11-02, GSC URL Inspection 2026-10-29, inventory 2026-11-02

## Evidence
- Keyword Planner US (monthly): "quit smoking cold turkey" 1,600 and about ten close variants at the same volume (MEDIUM), "quitting nicotine cold turkey" 1,300, "quitting vaping cold turkey" 1,000, "quitting cold turkey" 720 (up 1.64x), "cold turkey nicotine withdrawal timeline" 320 (up 2.44x).
- URL Inspection (2026-10-29): "Crawled, currently not indexed", last crawl 2026-05-10. 687 words, flagged thin, 4 internal links in, 0 impressions.
- The October 27 research suppressed this until the indexing work; BLO-37 found that crawled-not-indexed pages are short and overlap stronger pages, and that the fix is a refresh, not a resubmission. This issue is that content fix for this URL.
- SERP check (web search, 2026-11-02): Quit Victoria, K Health, GoodRx, Healthline, LloydsPharmacy, plus NRT brands arguing against cold turkey. Mid-strength, mixed intent.

## Recommended action
Refresh in place to about 1,400 words: answer first (what cold turkey is and how it compares with using NRT or medication, with a sourced quit-rate comparison), what the first 72 hours and first weeks feel like (link /nicotine-withdrawal-timeline and the day guides), a day-by-day survival plan, when to add NRT, cold turkey for vapes and pouches in one short section linking /quit-vaping and /quit-zyn, FAQ. Sources: NHS, CDC, Smokefree.gov, Cochrane review on abrupt vs gradual quitting.
Don't claim cold turkey is the best or the worst method; present evidence neutrally. Don't request indexing before the refresh ships.

## Next skill
seo-content-brief

## Done when
URL Inspection shows the page indexed within 28 days of publishing, and it has impressions for "quit smoking cold turkey".

title: New page: can your lungs heal from vaping (/can-lungs-heal-from-vaping)
body:
URL: /can-lungs-heal-from-vaping
Cluster: can lungs heal from vaping
Type: new-content
Source: Keyword Planner US 2026-11-02, inventory 2026-11-02

## Evidence
- Keyword Planner US (monthly, LOW competition): "can your lungs heal from vaping" 1,300, "can lungs heal after 3 years of vaping" 720. Trend 0.5-0.8x.
- No existing page covers the vaping intent. /can-lungs-heal-after-smoking (2,757 words, published 2026-10-15) is about cigarettes only; /quit-vaping-timeline is "Discovered, not indexed".
- SERP check (web search, 2026-11-02): dominated by scraped Q&A sites, a respiratory therapy blog, Baptist Health, Allen Carr and vape-company FAQs. Few authoritative answers, so rankability is good.
- Fits two priorities: vaping (support confirmed 2026-10-27) and Blou's lung check feature.

## Recommended action
Write a ~1,400-word page: answer first (what is known about lung recovery after vaping and what is not), what vaping does to airways, what improves after stopping and roughly when (only figures with a source), when to see a doctor (persistent cough, wheeze, chest pain, EVALI warning signs), and how to track breathing (lung checks in Blou, described with APP_FEATURES only). Link from /can-lungs-heal-after-smoking and /quit-vaping; link out to /vape-withdrawal-symptoms.
Risk: the long-term research is limited. Every recovery claim needs CDC, NASEM (2018), AHA/ALA or a peer-reviewed source; say plainly where evidence is missing. No invented timelines, no "popcorn lung" scare framing.

## Next skill
seo-content-brief

## Done when
The page is indexed within 21 days of publishing and has impressions for "can your lungs heal from vaping" within 28 days.
